content.comment_body: Hello, Does anyone know if an Apple Mac Mini M1 running Windows 11 (64-bit) through Parallels can run [product_name] V8? I tried launching it, but it starts briefly and then stops. I’m unsure if the issue is with [product_name] or Windows. Any help would be appreciated. [user_name]
Try uninstalling [product_name]. Then reinstall it, making sure to start the setup as an administrator. After installation, always run [product_name] as an administrator.
Hello! You can find installation requirements for your operating system at the end of this [url]. Best regards!
Please avoid posting multiple times for the same issue. You’ve also created another topic about getting [product_name] to work with an M1 Mac under Parallels.
Which version of [product_name] are you using? V8.0 is not compatible with Windows 10 or 11.

Will [company_name] stop supporting Mac users entirely? M1 Macs have been available for over two years, but there’s still no update for a 64-bit Mac version of [product_name]. There are 64-bit versions for Windows and Linux, and since this is a Java application, it should be straightforward to update. I’ve been using [product_name] for 15 years, please consider this.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report compatibility problems running [product_name] V8 on Apple Mac Mini M1 via Parallels and Windows 11 64-bit. The software fails to launch, and users are unsure whether the cause lies with [company_name]'s application or the computing environment. There is concern about the absence of native support for macOS M1, especially given its widespread use and the existence of 64-bit versions for other platforms.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to function correctly either through virtualization or as native support on current Mac hardware, especially with 64-bit architecture. Timely updates are also expected to ensure support for widely adopted platforms like Apple M1.
